groups.defaultsDesc: Color used in a channel's atlas for materials that have no texture in that channel.

channels.label: Channels to pack
channels.desc: One atlas per channel, all with the same layout. Maps a model samples through its remapped UVs are always packed, even if unchecked.

maxSize.label: Max atlas size
maxSize.desc: Pages are always a power of two, never larger than this.

extrude.label: Extrude
extrude.desc: Edge pixels repeated around each texture so mipmaps and filtering do not bleed. 4–8 px recommended.

textureScale.label: Texture scale
textureScale.desc: Resize every texture before packing (e.g. 50% to fit more in one atlas).

scaleToFit.label: Shrink to fit one page
scaleToFit.desc: Halve the scale (down to 1/8) until everything fits in one atlas.

multiPage.label: Allow several pages
multiPage.desc: Extra atlas sets when one page is not enough. A model is kept on one page whenever possible.

inset.label: UV inset
inset.desc: How far inside its rectangle UV 0 and 1 land. Half a texel avoids sampling the neighbour.

outOfRange.label: UVs outside 0–1
outOfRange.desc: Tiling textures cannot be atlased as is.

maxTiles.label: Max repeats per axis
maxTiles.desc: Bake repeats stores the texture N×M times in the atlas.

outputMode.label: Output
outputMode.rewriteDesc: Writes remapped copies of the models that use the atlas.
outputMode.remapDesc: Leaves models untouched: writes <model>.uvremap.json files and a Unity import script that applies them.

mergeMaterials.label: Merge materials
mergeMaterials.desc: Atlased materials of a model become one material (fewer draw calls).

verifyGeometry.label: Verify geometry
verifyGeometry.desc: Re-imports each written model and compares it with the source. Always on for FBX unless allowed under Advanced.

autoFallback.label: Fall back to UV remap data
autoFallback.desc: If a rewritten model fails the check (or needs several atlas pages), write UV remap data for it instead.

copySourceModels.label: Copy source models
copySourceModels.desc: Copy the untouched model next to its .uvremap.json.

allowUnverifiedFbx.label: Allow unverified FBX
allowUnverifiedFbx.desc: Lets you turn the geometry check off for FBX output. Not recommended.

list.dropHint: FBX, OBJ and DAE. Models are never modified; outputs go to the folder you choose.

preview.empty: Add models to see the atlas layout

toast.doneRemap: Packed: UV remap data for {{count}} models, {{skipped}} skipped
toast.importDuplicates: These models are already in the list
toast.importNothing: No FBX, OBJ or DAE models found
